name: Artt
source:
It is refreshing to meet an object who is really passionate about their own subject! Artt, art, loves art! He is just so excited to look at it, hang it up, talk about it. And he really wants to know what you think. Don't worry about answering the wrong thing - it'll always be an artistic choice with this fellow.
Likes: Animated Discussion, Beauty in All Its Forms, The Sharing of Ideas
Dislikes: Close-mindedness, Bare Walls, Willful Ignorance

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
